description: This file declares the class ProtobufIRDumper, which is responsible for converting various IR (Intermediate Representation) types into Protocol Buffer format and dumping them to a specified path. It is part of a larger header-checking tool in the Android Open Source Project and utilizes multiple protobuf-related headers to perform its conversions.

classes.name: ProtobufIRDumper
classes.description: A class that converts IR types into Protocol Buffer messages and dumps the results for header checking.

methods.description: Constructor that initializes the dumper with a dump path and creates a new translation unit.

methods.description: Performs the dump operation for the provided module IR.
